status: M0 change map, generated from the OfficeIMO 3.5.3 net8.0 build (b7d2cf5137) by reflection plus source lookup. Signatures are reflection renderings: default values are unquoted and "CancellationToken cancellationToken = null" means "= default".

frameworks.change: Drop net8.0 and net472; no conditional code.

htmlDependency.today: ProjectReferences OfficeIMO.Word.Html and OfficeIMO.Markdown.Html, which bring OfficeIMO.Html and AngleSharp.

callSites.use: Raw HTML blocks and HTML comments in Markdown (BlockRenderer.cs:256, 262) are inserted through the Word HTML importer.
TryRenderHtmlFallbackViaMarkdownAst: HTML fragments are converted back to Markdown AST and rendered natively.

htmlDependency.otherUsings: MarkdownToWordConverter.cs, .Images.cs, .SharedRendering.cs, .Formatting.cs and .BlockRenderer.cs have "using OfficeIMO.Word.Html; using OfficeIMO.Markdown.Html;" but no other type use (verify at compile time).
removal: Add an internal raw-HTML hook to WordMarkdownImportOptions (for example Func<string, WordDocument, bool> or an IWordMarkdownHtmlRenderer interface) that defaults to a non-HTML fallback: emit the raw HTML as literal/code text and record an OfficeDiagnostic ("html-block-as-text").

OfficeIMO.Word.Html registers the real HTML renderer when present: either an opt-in extension (options.UseHtmlBlocks()) in OfficeIMO.Word.Html, or the OfficeIMO front door wires it so the default bundle keeps today's behavior.
Drop both ProjectReferences; OfficeIMO.Word.Markdown then references Core, Word and Markdown only.
Behavior change: users of OfficeIMO.Word.Markdown alone lose HTML-block fidelity unless they also install OfficeIMO.Word.Html (or OfficeIMO). Document in MIGRATION.md.
htmlDependency.readmeImpact: README mentions ToHtmlViaMarkdown/ToHtmlFragmentViaMarkdown/SaveAsHtmlViaMarkdown, which are not in the current public API (stale README to fix with M4).

openQuestions: Raw HTML blocks lose fidelity when only OfficeIMO.Word.Markdown is installed; acceptable default?
